name: Hananiah
overview: Hananiah was a male figure known primarily as the commander of the fortress in Jerusalem. The biblical record does not specify his tribal affiliation or provide additional personal details. His role as a military leader highlights his importance in the defense and administration of Jerusalem during his time.
namesAndTitles: The name Hananiah means 'YHWH is gracious,' reflecting a recognition of God's grace in his identity. This proper name is recorded in Nehemiah 7:2 and does not indicate that it was given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Hananiah beyond his role as commander of the fortress in Jerusalem. No other personal or familial connections are mentioned in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Hananiah's significance lies in his leadership position as commander of the fortress in Jerusalem, a key role in maintaining the safety and stability of the city. His mention in Nehemiah underscores the organized efforts to secure Jerusalem during the post-exilic period. Though details are sparse, his military command reflects the trust placed in him during a critical time for the Jewish community.
